finding.headline: "The Scattered-Papers Mum" (No Omugwo, No System)
finding.problem: "I have the documents somewhere but I can't find the one I need when the paediatrician or HR asks. I cry over a missing paper at 2am."
finding.person: New mum, husband works, no nearby family (no omugwo confinement help), discharge papers + vaccine card + insurance forms split between drawer, phone photo, and email.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone flagship (Master Baby-Admin Binder) + Bundle hub.". Verdict: PASSES.
